summary: Stitches polygonal boundary cracks by matching nearby boundary pieces and snapping high-detail edges to low-detail edges.

key_params.name: corners
key_params.note: Point numbers treated as boundary breaks

key_params.name: consolidate
key_params.note: Consolidate snapped points along the boundary

key_params.name: findcorner
key_params.note: Automatically find corner points by angle

common_gotchas: Spatially coincident edges are not enough; boundary uniqueness is based on point numbers.
Consolidation happens along the boundary, not across the whole surface.
Tolerance and corner angle settings can over-stitch separate pieces if set too broadly.
key_concepts: Polystitch SOP repairs cracks between polygonal surfaces evaluated at differing levels of detail.
Boundary uniqueness is determined by point numbers rather than spatial position.
Boundaries are split at corner points, either manually or by an automatic angle threshold.
Boundary pieces within tolerance are stitched by snapping high-detail points to the lower-detail edge.
